$comment: Every third-party component Jigsmith builds with, links or ships. tools/license_audit.py fails CI if a dependency is missing here, has a license not on the allow-list, or lacks a notice entry in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.

dependencies.name: Open CASCADE Technology
dependencies.notice: visible notice required (About box, README, CLI --help)
